scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:e2e
scripts.test:e2e: cargo build --quiet --package ctxmux --package ctxmux-daemon && CTXMUX_BIN="$PWD/target/debug/ctxmux" CTXMUXD_BIN="$PWD/target/debug/ctxmuxd" npm run test:e2e --workspace @ctxmux/sdk
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present && npm run typecheck:scripts
scripts.typecheck:scripts: tsc --noEmit --target ES2024 --module NodeNext --moduleResolution NodeNext --types node --allowImportingTsExtensions --strict --noUncheckedIndexedAccess --exactOptionalPropertyTypes scripts/codex-semantic-canary.ts scripts/reliability-qualification.ts
